image_description: The image displays two adult bison standing in a dry, grassy field with a blurred background of trees. The bison on the right is in the foreground, facing left, showing its massive shoulder hump, shaggy dark brown fur, and head profile. The bison on the left is slightly behind, also facing left. Both animals exhibit the characteristic heavy forequarters and lighter hindquarters.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large broad head with short curved horns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Both visible heads are large and broad. The horns are clearly visible, short, and curved upward/inward, matching the species description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct beard of long, dark hair hangs from the chin and throat area of both animals.
The eye of the foreground bison is visible and appears dark, consistent with the taxonomy.
Ears are not prominently sticking out; they appear small and are largely obscured by the thick fur of the head.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Massive body with exceptionally tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The silhouette shows a massive build, particularly high at the shoulders (withers), tapering down towards the rear.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The forequarters are covered in thick, shaggy dark brown fur, creating a very prominent hump shape.
The fur on the rear flank and hind legs is visibly shorter and smoother compared to the dense mane on the front.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short horns compared to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Relative to the massive bulk of the head and body, the horns are proportionally short.
The lower legs and feet are obscured by the tall, dry grass in the foreground, making it impossible to verify the hooves.
The tails of both animals are either hidden behind their bodies or obscured by the angle and vegetation.

The image correctly depicts the massive shoulder hump, shaggy forequarter fur, shorter hindquarter fur, beard, and horn shape. Non-testable checkpoints (hooves, tail) are occluded by environment/pose, which is expected in natural photography. Perfect class conformance.
